correctness.rationale: The inverse-degree martingale h(S)=sum_{v in S}1/d(v) divided by Z is harmonic by edge-by-edge cancellation. The conditional first moment satisfies (I-Q)u=h with self-loops included; 2..4-vertex equal-degree vertices are automorphic within each connected graph class. The source census uses all 2^(n choose 2) labelled masks, all vertex permutations, exact Fraction linear solves and lists seven canonical masks. An independently coded five-vertex canonical-graph enumeration and 30-transient-state Fraction Markov solve verifies all 21 classes and the exact seven canonical masks 29,58,62,185,187,221,254. Independent path-chain computation yields p(1)=p(2)=1/7, times 14650/329 and 26955/658, gap 335/94.
residual_risks: Independent check is bounded to the stated finite ranges; any unrestricted proof rests on analyzed mathematics rather than numerical output.

value.rationale: Smallest size at which neutral reproductive value fails to determine success-CONDITIONAL time for the same graph is a natural structural benchmark. The seven-of-21 layer and exact path witness give an independently useful finite population/network result.
